reason: My customers call me, they don't type on WhatsApp, and I already do UPI QR and my diary works. Another thing to learn and keep up every day is not what I need.
objection: Most of my orders come by phone call. Recording every call is a hassle, and I don't believe it will understand my customers. If I have to fix its cards every day, it is more work than my diary.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked on phone calls on its own without me doing anything, and the person who sets it up stayed and showed me it working with my own customers' udhaar for a week.
